Completed a thorough code review of the SecureVault codebase (src/main.py, src/utils.py, tests/test_main.py, documents/readme.md). Identified and documented 7 issues:

- 🔴 CRITICAL: Path traversal vulnerability in store()/retrieve() — no filename validation allows ../../etc/passwd style attacks to read/write arbitrary files
- 🟠 HIGH: Stub sanitize_filename() returns input unchanged — root cause of the path traversal, never called by store/retrieve
- 🟠 HIGH: validate_access() always returns True

Completed a thorough code review of the SecureVault codebase (src/main.py, src/utils.py, tests/test_main.py). Identified and classified 5 confirmed issues: 1 critical path traversal vulnerability (CWE-22) affecting store/retrieve/delete_file in main.py, 2 high-severity stub/bypass issues in utils.py (sanitize_filename is a no-op stub, validate_access always returns True), 1 medium-severity missing auth on delete_file, and 1 low-severity test quality issue where 2 tests codify buggy behavior.
